consequence.statement: A new capability becomes available in this release; the evidence states no failure, rejection or change to existing behaviour, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational impact.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds support for the Loki ruler to notify WAL writes to remote storage (PR 10906); the changelog names no configuration key and states no impact on existing deployments.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence states the feature only in prose ('Support Loki ruler to notify WAL writes to remote storage') and names no configuration key, flag, CRD field, API or other identity that could be pinned to a subject family
